description_summary: Use when watching GitHub PR check/review deltas, resuming event cursors or running bounded authorized Codex cloud review rounds.
should_trigger: Watch this pull request for new review comments and check results.
Monitor PR deltas in the background until a terminal state.
Resume the PR watcher from its saved event cursor.
Watch only the CI checks for this existing pull request.
Request bounded Codex cloud review rounds for the current PR head.
should_trigger_test: Stop watching when the PR closes or the configured duration expires.
Detect a stale review completion that belongs to an older head commit.
should_not_trigger: Address the unresolved review comments on this GitHub pull request.
Run local Codex review and fix findings until the bounded loop is clean.
Walk me through the reasoning behind this existing implementation plan.
Record this reviewed exact package artifact in dependency-vet.json.
